note: ticks read on the crop (150 dpi): x ticks (the .03/.10 tick is the foot of the y axis) and the x axis (y = -15) and zero line (y = 0) at each tick column, y ticks on the y axis; the drawn axes are not quite orthogonal and the x tick spacing is uneven, so x is piecewise between the drawn ticks (xgrid) and y is the affine fit
